name: PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk
summary: PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk operates a chain of department stores in Indonesia. It operates through Fashion and Accessories; and Groceries segments. The company sells clothes, accessories, bags, shoes, cosmetics, and daily needs for men, women, and children through its department stores and supermarkets. It offers its products under the EMBA CLASSIC, S135, M231, EMBA JEANS, BENHILL, TWIST, PINGU, GABRIELLE, LARUSSO, HOMYPED LADIES, FLADEO, and CARVIL brands. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Ramayana Makmursentosa.
